title: Offline password manager
blurb: A small, focused password tool. Offline password manager does one job properly, runs offline, and keeps your data on your device.
differences: Unlimited entries, not a three item trial
Light and dark, whichever you prefer
Stored on your own disk, never sent anywhere
Takes every entry out to one file you control
Brings entries in from another manager
Stores site, username and password together in one place
